name: Host creates a phone and generates a pairing code
description: Verifies a host can create a phone record and obtain a one-time pairing string for the Android agent.
steps: Sign in with the test identity
Add Samsung Galaxy A54 in Latvia with Android 14 and 5G
Click Connect on the new phone
expected: A pairing panel appears below the phone with a one-time pairing string and a copy button.

name: Host device list shows connection state after reload
setup: Sign in as a host and add a phone
description: Verifies host device status is server-derived and remains visible after reloading the dashboard.
expected: The phone remains listed with a connection badge and last-heartbeat information.

name: Renter is kept out of host device management
description: Verifies a renter receives the renter dashboard without host pairing controls.
steps: Sign in with a fresh test identity
expected: The renter dashboard is visible and no Add phone or Connect controls are shown.

name: Phone form rejects missing required details
setup: Sign in and choose Phone owner
description: Verifies incomplete device information is blocked and no phone is added.
steps: Leave Model empty while filling Country and Android version
expected: Required-field validation blocks submission and the phone count does not increase.

name: Language selection survives reload
description: Verifies the language selector changes and persists the interface language.
steps: Change language from Russian to English
Confirm the rent action is in English
expected: English remains selected and the interface stays in English.
